features.name: tenure_normalized
features.description: Employee tenure normalized to [0,1] range using training set min/max bounds, capturing career stage as a smooth continuous score
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth linear projection of tenure useful for SVM margin separation

features.name: cognitive_composite_score
features.description: Weighted composite of logical and verbal scores normalized by their combined range, representing overall cognitive ability
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two correlated cognitive measures into a single smooth composite for linear separability

features.name: training_score_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of training score from the training set mean, measuring how atypical an employee's training performance is
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures outlier performance patterns that may correlate with atypical employment outcomes

features.name: literacy_normalized
features.description: Average literacy score normalized to [0,1] using training set bounds, representing educational background as a smooth continuous feature
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized literacy measure suitable for linear SVM weight optimization

features.name: cultural_fit_score
features.description: Composite of similar language percentage and distance penalty, measuring cultural and geographic alignment with workplace
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures cultural integration factors that may influence employee retention as a single smooth score

features.name: location_maturity_ratio
features.description: Ratio of employee tenure to location age, indicating how long the employee has been at the location relative to the location's total age
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative seniority within a location context, useful for linear margin separation

features.name: distance_log_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed distance to workplace, compressing the right tail for more linear-friendly distribution
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transformation reduces skewness in distance distribution, improving linear SVM performance

features.name: cognitive_literacy_interaction
features.description: Product of normalized cognitive composite and normalized literacy, capturing joint effect of cognitive ability and educational background
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates a nonlinear interaction term as a single feature, extending linear SVM expressiveness

features.name: verbal_logical_gap
features.description: Absolute difference between verbal and logical scores normalized by their combined range, measuring cognitive profile imbalance
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures cognitive skill imbalance which may indicate fit issues, providing additional linear discriminative signal

features.name: gender_weighted_cultural_fit
features.description: Cultural fit score adjusted by gender indicator, capturing potential gender-specific cultural integration patterns
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides gender-differentiated cultural fit signal that may improve linear margin for demographic subgroups

features.name: overall_employee_risk_index
features.description: Holistic semantic assessment of employee flight risk based on combination of short tenure, high distance, low cultural fit, and low cognitive scores. Score from 0 (very low risk) to 10 (very high risk) based on pattern matching across multiple dimensions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantically grounded composite risk score that captures non-linear interactions as a single smooth feature for SVM

features.name: workplace_integration_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of how well an employee is likely integrated into their workplace based on language similarity, distance, location age, and tenure. Score from 0 (poorly integrated) to 10 (highly integrated).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures holistic workplace integration that combines geographic, cultural, and temporal factors into a single continuous score for linear SVM
